title: Maharashtra Sets a New Benchmark with Complete Digitalisation of Taekwondo Administration
snippet: In the future, this technology could serve as a unified digital governance framework for multiple sports, thereby enhancing the efficiency of sports
extractedText: Taekwondo Maharashtra Sets a New Benchmark with Complete Digitalisation of Taekwondo Administration Fake Certificates and Age Fraud Curbed; Taekwondo Association of Maharashtra Creates a New Model for Sports Governance 30 Jun 2026 Other 247 reads Facebook X WhatsApp Telegram Email Mumbai: The Taekwondo Association of Maharashtra (TAM) has ushered in a new era of sports governance by successfully implementing a comprehensive digital management system for Taekwondo across the state. This landmark initiative has transformed sports administration through technology, setting a new benchmark for transparency, efficiency, and accountability in Indian sports. The advanced online platform, operational for over a year, addresses several long-standing challenges in sports administration, including age fraud, fake certificates, duplicate registrations, and the absence of a centralized player database. With a secure player verification mechanism, every registered athlete now has a unique and permanent digital identity, ensuring authenticity and credibility at every stage. The platform offers dedicated login facilities for district associations, academies, and athletes, along with online tournament registration, a centralized player database, and a 100% cashless payment system. Every athlete is provided with a permanent digital profile containing personal information, tournament performances, belt promotion history, medals, achievements, referee qualifications, and coaching certifications. These records are securely stored and can be verified instantly whenever required. One of the platform's most significant innovations is its *automated digital certificate management system. Upon completion of tournaments or technical workshops, certificates are generated automatically and delivered directly to the athlete's registered email address. This has virtually eliminated paperwork while preventing the creation of fake certificates or manipulation of official records. In the near future, the Association also plans to introduce a Player Rating System to enable scientific performance evaluation and talent tracking. The visionary behind this digital transformation is Dr. Prasad Kulkarni, Treasurer of the Taekwondo Association of Maharashtra. Having experienced the challenges faced by athletes firsthand, he conceptualized the platform with the primary objective of protecting genuine players and ensuring a transparent, technology-driven ecosystem. According to Dr. Kulkarni, the system can be effectively adopted across all combat sports as well as individual and team sports throughout India. The technical execution of the project was led by *Ashutosh Joshi, Director of Bliss Technology Labs and a State Taekwondo medalist. Association President Sandeep Ombase and General Secretary Gaffar Pathan described the initiative as a strong foundation for Taekwondo's future in Maharashtra. The project's successful implementation was made possible by the active support of Vice Presidents Tushar Awate and Ghanshyam Sanap, Secretary Suresh Chaudhari, and Executive Committee Members Pramod Daunde, Narayan Waghade, and Padmakar Kamble. By leveraging cutting-edge technology to ensure transparency, authenticity, and athlete-centric governance, the Taekwondo Association of Maharashtra has created a pioneering model for sports administration in India. This initiative is expected to inspire sports federations across the country to embrace digital transformation and strengthen the future of Indian sports. A Solid Foundation for Future Generations The Association has always believed in adopting modern systems that directly benefit athletes and enhance transparency in sports administration. This digital platform has revolutionized the management of registrations, athlete records, certificates, and administrative processes. It will serve as a solid foundation for future generations of Taekwondo athletes. I congratulate Dr. Prasad Kulkarni for conceptualizing this initiative and commend Ashutosh Joshi and Bliss Technology Labs for successfully bringing this ambitious vision to fruition. - Sandeep Ombase, President, Taekwondo Association of Maharashtra. Significant Boost in Efficiency Digitization has led to substantial improvements in operational efficiency and service delivery across the state. Registrations, athlete management, communication, certification, and all financial transactions are now managed through a single, integrated platform. This has not only reduced the administrative burden but also vastly improved transparency in the sport by bringing all stakeholders onto one platform. This technology-driven administration will prove to be a milestone in making the state's sports sector more dynamic and reliable. - Gafar Pathan, General Secretary, Taekwondo Association of Maharashtra.
